blocks.html:
A step in bringing the physical indexes in line with the loaded definitions.

Planned and executed separately, like link migrations, so that `db:migrate`
can show what it is about to do. Every action is idempotent: running the plan
twice is a no-op.

types.name: SearchIndexMigrationAction
types.description:
A step in bringing the physical indexes in line with the loaded definitions.

Planned and executed separately, like link migrations, so that `db:migrate`
can show what it is about to do. Every action is idempotent: running the plan
twice is a no-op.

children.name: action
children.description:
No version of this index has ever gone live. A new version is built,
to be filled and made active at application start.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index to create.

children.name: physical_name
children.description: The physical index the new version is built under.

children.name: definition_hash
children.description: A hash of the definition the version is created from.

children.name: active_physical_name
children.description: The physical index of the version currently serving reads.

children.name: active_definition_hash
children.description: A hash of the definition the active version was built from.

children.name: provider
children.description: The provider the new version is built on.

children.name: previous_provider
children.description:
The provider that holds the version currently serving reads. Set only
when it differs from `provider`, so a later migration knows to clean up
the previous engine's data once this version becomes active.
